notes.title: 2 WEDDINGS and a CONVENTION - Lamb Vlog Up Now!
notes.content:
Documentary Time!

If you missed it, last year was HUGE for our development team. It was Massive Monster's (our studio's) 10-year anniversary, and we wanted to make it SPECIAL.

Last October, at PAXAus, we built a faithful recreation of the Cult of the Lamb Temple - and legally bound two amazing couples in unholy matrimony... in front of the entirety of PAX! We even threw a Cult of the Lamb rave (of course, all in the name of work and business. We're very professional). 

We just released a documentary about what it is like for Devs at conventions, and all of the above (spoiler; wedding planning is not for the faint or weak of heart).

[previewyoutube=yRp-LMPHNFw;full][/previewyoutube]

Thank you so much for all of your support, to our incredible players all around the world. We couldn't have come this far without you - and hopefully we'll be able to attend more events around the world! ❤️

Back to today... 

As of now, we have spent the last few months crunching, focusing on creating even MORE exciting newness for Cult of the Lamb, and waging war on those pesky bugs. If you run into any, please report it in-game via the pause menu, and our Monster's will be on the case.

We can't wait to share more info with you about what we have been working on!

6 Years of Love!

If you have voted for us for this award that is incredibly appreciated, but either way we just want to take this opportunity again to thank you immensely. Your support over the years is what has allowed us to keep working on the game we love so much. 

Cult of the Lamb has been in active development for around 6 years now, and we've spent so much time expanding the game with more characters, lore, content, local co-op and more! 

We could not have created our latest update without our incredible community. Unholy Alliance was almost entirely made up of all the feedback and suggestions we have heard from players - from traits and questlines, to the much anticipated local co-op feature. 

So, What's Next? 

Well, it's still a tiny bit early to share... but what I can say is, we're working on something big for this game! Like Unholy Alliance, we've taken in feedback from players feedback, suggestions, and what's coming next will answer many of your questions since the last update!

What's in The Pilgrim Pack? 
The Full Pilgrim Comic Story and Bonus Pages!

Get ready to discover the world of Cult of the Lamb as you’ve never seen it before, as you set off for a perilous adventure with Jalala and Rinor across the Lands of the Old Faith!

Uncover mysteries, dodge dangerous Cultists looking for their next sacrifice, and mysterious mushroom peddlers... but watch out. For there are rumours of a wicked beast who stalks the land, searching for their next victim...

Watch the below video, to get a little taste of the comic, lovingly illustrated and written by our artist Carles Dalmau, and Head of Narrative, Jojo Zhou. 

[previewyoutube=d2D3BvgHmps;full][/previewyoutube]

You will be able to access the comic/bonus pages from the main menu in-game. You will be able to choose from 2 different viewing modes - either traditional, or animated (which includes sound and music). The choices you make will affect how you experience the story!

notes.title: † Major FREE Update UNHOLY ALLIANCE Out Now! †
notes.content:
Unholy Alliance, our next FREE major content update, is now available to play! 

Today, we're announcing the release of our next free major content update, as well as our new Pilgrim Pack DLC! 

[previewyoutube=rjeyYMuGZgU;full][/previewyoutube]
As well as the addition of co-op play, the Unholy Alliance expansion also adds new tarot cards, relics, buildings, fleeces, Follower traits, Follower quests, and other secrets to discover! 

To play all the new content, make sure your game is fully updated. For a TLDR; summary, see the patch notes here. 

We have also launched The Pilgrim Pack! This DLC consists of a brand new interactive digital comic, where your choices will take you on a colourful adventure! Alongside adding in new secret quests, Follower forms, outfits and decorations for your beloved Cult.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2890190/Cult_of_the_Lamb_Pilgrim_Pack/

Friends Who Slay Together, Stay Together: Local Co-op

Summoned by blood, and born in corruption. The Goat is a wicked new ally that can join the holy Lamb in LOCAL CO-OP! Experience the entire Cult of the Lamb campaign, with one player inhabiting the role of the Lamb and the other taking on the mantle of the Goat! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/af07ba916bb16841467c877e01d72e0ed70a5bb8.gif

How to Start Co-op Play
Simply plug in or connect a controller if you're playing on the same PC, and configure co-op in the pause menu to get started. 

Steam Remote Play is also enabled for those of you who are further away from each other - please note that you may run into issues with this, if both players are using a keyboard due to how Remote Play is set up. For best results without having to use a work around, please have at least 1 player using a controller. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/bc86a9a62ce7d231e841b2d881c0e51a6566651e.gif

Enjoy new ways to interact with the world of Cult together - from fishing to cult chores and knucklebones, plus much more! Choose from a selection of corrupted weapons, tarot cards, curses, and relics as you embark on co-op crusades together to defeat all who stand in your way. 

The Final Bishop Questline
You have defeated them - now it is time to truly make them a part of your Cult. 

10 in-game days after the Bishop relic quests, a Bishop will return to you with a quest. Complete these to cleanse them, unlock a new trait, and for a final reward from Narinder. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/945a46e3a48d341d5df88d7da724d4cd33eb86a0.gif

21 New Traits For Your Followers
This update brings with it a whopping 21 NEW traits for you to expand your Cult following with! 

Jerk Follower Change
We heard you loud and clear, these Followers are meant to be annoying, but not THIS annoying! To remove the 'Jerk' trait, you can either reassure, or bully them into submission. We'll leave the choice up to you... 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/d975f7b587cfea37828de9c8a51b15d011c06bab.gif

Poet
Followers with this trait will never work, and instead choose to sit near the edge of the base, crafting poetry all day, with some special lines unique to each major boss you defeat. Make sure you have defeated the first boss to unlock this trait! 

Cursed
Followers may acquire this grisly trait after being resurrected! They cannot perform any tasks, and have limited interactions. Cure them through the Medical Bay, or.. you know.. just let 'em be. What's the worse that could happen?

Community Requested Traits! Pettable, Polyamorous
Now you can shower love on ALL your Followers, no matter what they look like! Followers with the 'Pettable' trait will have the 'Pet' action in their radial wheels. Followers with the 'Polyamorous' trait will not be jealous if the Lamb gets married to other Followers.

...Plus, 17 other new traits!
Spy, Nightowl, Snorer, Drowsy, Catatonic, Inspired/Excited/Disturbed by Mission, Unlawful, Reformed/Scarred/ Hardened Criminal, Unhappily/Happily Married, Proud/Overwhelmed Parent, and Murderously Jealous Spouse. Phew!

Knucklebones Table & Nursery

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/860cbe6f1e16614dd870e21ccad973e580fb2556.gif

Nursery Building
You may assign up to three babies in the Nursery, and you can build as many as you like. Babies placed in the Nursery will not be able to escape baby jail until they become adults. This is available in the Divine Inspiration Menu. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/cde0b7d9d0f16aad8b883efb8eb0a805dfffee89.gif

Knucklebones Building 
This single build structure will allow you to play one match a day against a Follower of your choosing. Difficulty will be based on their Follower level - win the match to level them up instantly. Fun fact: you can also play against The Goat/Player 2! Defeat all of the Knucklebones gang at Ratau's place to get this table. 

New Fleeces, and Transmog System

New Fleeces
The Goat Fleece, unlocked in the Crown Menu once you unlock corrupted Relics and Tarots, will allow players to play as The Goat in single player!

Small update note: If that doesn't work, please try enabling co-op once, then checking the Crown Menu. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/adf5c33cbb5394f0d0d2a3d6eabaddeff18e7a47.gif

You've Yee'd your last 'Haw. The Cowboy Fleece allows players to don a shiny Sherriff's star, and play as Cowboy Lamb - with a special bleat animation to boot, too! This is available after the unlocking the Blunderbuss, and allows players to start with this weapon during runs. 

Fleece Transmog System
Pressing the 'Custom Appearance' button on a fleece will allow you to assign the visual fleece design of your choice, while keeping the selected fleece's traits. This feature can be found in the Crown menu, and is available once you unlock at least one fleece. Though be warned, this feature is not available on purely cosmetic fleeces. 

New Relics & Tarots! 
New varieties of Relics and Tarots have been added in this update for more fun - whether you're playing solo or with a friend! 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/a768ae0532989ae0bf32d536fc53c0cbf03c9077.gif

Blessed & Damned Relics
These are variants that add either a further positive, or negative effect to existing relics. 

While Blessed Relics will have a more 'heavenly' effect (such as blue hearts), Damned Relics will have a more 'hellish' effect (such as diseased hearts). Corrupted Relics have both a negative and positive effect (for example, taking damage whilst damaging all enemies).  

5 new Co-op Relics add more ways to strategize! Swap weapons, make your friend invincible, and more! These only drop in co-op mode. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/6b4bac884b536ad05262ff667f51b6ebb4cfb1dc.gif

New regular Tarots have been added for more fun! Pick 'Blind Wrath' to strike an enemy with lighting, or 'Usurper Blessed' to even heal fully when you enter the Boss room! 

Corrupted Tarot Cards 
With great power, comes cost. 'The Hoarder' will allow you to recover full health, at the cost of damage when you use relics. 'Blighted Core' will make all enemies take huge damage - at the cost of you taking double damage. 

Co-op Tarot Cards 
Because slaying with friends is more fun! Connect to each other through a damaging beam to run through your enemies, or even deal critical damage when you attack at the same time! 

How to Unlock New Tarot Cards and Relics
Upon defeating the final boss, [spoiler]The One Who Waits[/spoiler], the next time you are defeated in a dungeon, a room will appear. Interact with the cursed totem in that room to unlock Corrupted Relics & Tarot Cards. New relics will automatically appear during crusades, or in the Mystic Seller's item pool. 

Co-op Tarot Cards and Relics will unlock upon adding a second player to the experience for the first time, and will only appear in crusades when Co-Op Mode is enabled. 

Force Weapon Mode
Find this new feature in the Accessibility Settings! Toggling this will allow you to select the weapon you want to see appear on every weapon pedestal during runs. 

Twitch Integration
We've made many changes to the Twitch Integration system with this update! 

 Completely reworked extension backend to improve stability and speed of all integration features
 Reworked follower customization flow: Viewers can now customize their follower on a per-channel basis beforehand! Entering and winning a raffle will now make them appear in-game immediately. Once their follower is in-game, they will no longer be able to customize it until the player loads a new save in which the viewer has no follower yet. 
 Viewers who have not customized their follower yet will not be able to enter the raffle
 Added support for playing a game of Knucklebones against Twitch chat
 More Help or Hinder options


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/bf29bfae0aaf6d9bfa26d37c412ff3fe8c0c75f4.png

New DLC: The Pilgrim Pack OUT NOW 
[previewyoutube=NDAzfpw3Wfg;full][/previewyoutube]

Join Jalala and Rinor as they journey across the Lands of the Old Faith, dodging danger and peril as they search for a place to call home!

A Message From Us 
This update is a love letter from us, to you - the community. 🙏THE 🐑.🙏 THE 🐐. 

Love and Devotion, 
Massive Monster

Version 1.4.3 - Unholy Alliance Patch Notes 

New Features
Local Co-op

 Have a friend join you locally as The Goat and play Cult of the Lamb in Co-op!

Buildings

 Nursery - Send baby followers to the nursery to look after them in a group.
 Knucklebones Table - Verse followers or a friend at the knucklebones table.

Traits

 Poet - Never work and have no interactions; they will sit near the edge of the base, writing poetry all day.
 Unlawful - Has a small chance each phase to break out of prison, and can even break other followers out of prison.
 Snorer - Followers with the Snorer trait wake up followers who are sleeping nearby by snoring loudly at night. 
 Insomniac - Followers with the Insomniac trait sleep during the day and work at night. 
 Inspired by Mission - Followers with this trait will only have positive conversations with other followers.
 Excited by Mission - Followers with this trait will have higher mating chances after getting excited by their recent adventure.
 Disturbed by Mission - Followers with this trait will behave the same way as catatonic followers. Healing them will remove the trait.
 Polyamorous - Followers with this trait cannot get other wedding related traits upon getting married.
 Pettable - Followers with the Pettable trait can be pet regardless of their skin.
 Spy - Followers may join the cult by themselves with the Spy trait. Followers with this trait work and behave like any other followers and will leave the cult with 10% of gold after 5 days. 
 Reformed Criminal - Followers with this trait will be 10% more productive.
 Scarred Criminal - Followers with this trait will act like Coward followers.
 Hardened Criminal - Followers with this trait will act like Jerk followers.
 Happily Married - Followers with this trait will be 20% more productive.
 Unhappily Married - Followers with this trait will be 20% less productive.
 Jealous Spouse - Followers with this trait will keep fighting other spouses until they kill them.
 Murderous Spouse - Followers with this trait will keep fighting other spouses until they kill them. Followers with this trait always win fights.
 Cursed - Followers with this trait will not work and have limited interactions, they also eat other followers.
 Proud Parent - Proud parents have unique thoughts about their child and are able to hug them regardless of their age.
 Overwhelmed Parent - Overwhelmed parents will also have unique thoughts about their child, will generally look exhausted and will have more frequent negative conversations.
 Catatonic - Followers with this trait cannot perform any tasks and have limited interactions. 

Fleeces

 Goat Fleece - The Goat fleece is a cosmetic fleece allowing players to play the goat in single player.
 Cowboy Fleece - The Cowboy fleece forces the player to use the Blunderbuss.
 Transmog System - Interchange the appearance and abilities of fleeces.

Relics & Tarots

 Normal Relics - 12 normal new relics! 
 Corrupted Relics - 8 new corrupted relics! These relics grant some great powers, but come with a trade off.
 Co-op Relics - 5 Co-op relics that will only drop in Co-op!
 Tarot Cards
 Normal Tarot Cards - 9 new tarot cards!
 Corrupted Tarot Cards - 9 new corrupted tarot cards! These tarots grant some great powers, but come with a trade off.
 Co-op Tarot Cards - 5 Co-op tarot cards that will only drop in Co-op!

Accessibility

 Force Weapon Mode - Choose a type of weapon to spawn at all times.

New Misc Content

 Bishop Quests - Discover more lore about the Bishops in these new unique quests.
 Dungeon Encounters - All 4 dungeons have been populated with tons of new encounters.

Fixes & Changes

 Fixed occasional softlock when equipping a relic
 Fixed hearts and other pickups spawning outside of dungeon rooms
 Fixed users not unlocking the Axolotl form after completing the lighthouse quest
 Fixed an edge case where Sozo’s questline did not progress
 Fixed followers receiving the Disciple trait once they reach max level without doing the Disciple Ritual
 And plenty more various bug fixes!
 Stopped disciples from stealing other follower beds
 Children and parents can no longer become lovers with one another
 Added twitch decorations to mystic seller items
 Jerk’s can be reassured and bullied. Reassuring will remove their jerk trait

Twitch Extension

 Viewers can now customize their follower on a per-channel basis beforehand
 Entering and winning a raffle will now make them appear in-game immediately. Once their follower is in-game, they will no longer be able to customize it until the player loads a new save in which the viewer has no follower yet
 Viewers who have not customized their follower yet will not be able to enter the raffle

notes.title: † Major FREE Content Update SINS OF THE FLESH Out Now! †
notes.content:
Our next major content update for Cult of the Lamb, Sins of the Flesh, is now live! This is one of our most feature filled, cheekiest updates yet bringing new features, rituals, buildings, fixes and much more - including the return of a much missed old friend... 🍄

This is a completely free update that will download to your game automatically! 

We have also released the Sinful Pack! New Follower forms, lustful decorations, and cheeky outfits - all yours for a little extra, if you would like to help support the development of Cult of the Lamb. Check it out here! 

We have prepared a special deep dive into the Sins of the Flesh below! 

Click here for the Patch Notes.

[previewyoutube=dsCUA_VQ5Nw;full][/previewyoutube]
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/5f0831afd9ae2842806f60f5d91dc4ebe7de13b0.png

New Features

Sins and Disciples
Some rise by sin, and some by virtue fall. After defeating 3 Bishops (or if you are in post game), perform a Sermon, Doctrine or Ritual to unlock the new content! 


New progression systems add more depth and complexity to managing the Cult of the Lamb! By following the sinful path, your Followers will delight in gluttonous rituals, vain buildings, and 8 new wrathful doctrines. 

https://i.imgur.com/647afzf.gif

Followers can now generate a deliciously evil new resource, Sin, via rituals or building structures. Spend it on upgrading the Temple, removing the cooldown on purgatory, re-indoctrinating Followers and building shiny new structures!

New Rituals 
We have packed this update full of dark new rituals. Use them to lead your Followers into depravity, into the stinking mud of vile repudiation... and as a medium to harvest SIN. 

Perform the Rite of Lust, and choose your favourite Follower to become the Mayflower Leader! This flower crown clad Follower will gladly generate Sin for you. Followers will not work for half a day, and will instead prance around nakey. Just an average day at the Massive Monster office. 

https://i.imgur.com/5gAKbkz.gif

Oh, to be an anatomically incorrect nude animal frolicking with nothing but a leaf and freedom to my name...

Perform the Rite of Wrath - and watch Followers cause havoc! Choose your feistiest fellow to become the Wrath Leader. This Follower will chaotically generate Sin.

https://i.imgur.com/Dyx37Ox.gif

Or how about the Gluttony of Cannibals? Choose an unlucky Follower to be consumed in their entirety by the others, generating Sin and an inescapable sense of guilt for yourself. Unless you don't mind, in which case, you're just as much of a monster as we are.  

https://i.imgur.com/9wfhFEN.gif

If a Follower has Sinned too much, they will become consumed, and eventually damned. Perform Sinner’s Pride, and choose one sacrificial Follower to absolve all cult members of their Sin 🙏

To rescue Followers from their Damnation, find them during Crusades. They will seek you out, to destroy the cause of their suffering. Put an end to them three times during a Crusade, and revive them back at the Cult! If you can't find your Follower, try sorting the order by name. 

https://i.imgur.com/tDrlaie.gif

The Inner Circle of True Believers
Invite your most loyal Followers to the inner circle of Disciples, a revamped levelling system of Follower progression. The Discipleship Ritual will allow you to initiate a level 10 Follower, giving them the coveted position.

https://i.imgur.com/EKSPRbt.gif

Upon initiation, Disciples gain the Faith Trait (allowing them to re-educate those naughty dissenting Followers once a day), and can generate more Devotion compared to regular Followers. Follower level is now capped at 10 - Followers at max level can still participate in any interactions or Cult events that would normally increase their loyalty, but their loyalty bar will not appear anymore.

Build the Disciple Collection Shrine so your most faithful can deposit devotion from other buildings into one central spot! The Disciple Boost Shrine allows Disciples to pray, and by filling up a shrine, give the Lamb a boost for the next crusade. 

Decadent New Structures
Sins of the Flesh comes with extra space in your Cult, and brand new structures! 

The Drinkhouse 
Craft drinks at the Drinkhouse for your Followers! Once a Follower consumes their delicious little treat beverage, they will generate sweet, sweet Sin, at risk of becoming Befuddled. Followers will stumble around, puke, fight, chat, laugh, sing, and generally have a merry old time!

https://i.imgur.com/utYUN4f.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/4eb53fb4e89f73bd2abc9570814f53b37faa1b1a.png

If one of your beloved Followers finds themselves Injured from a particularly nasty scrap, they will limp around feeling sorry for themselves, until the 'Injured' state passes. 

The Mating Tent 

You asked for this. 

https://i.imgur.com/Sw0hDEU.gif

When two Followers love each other very much, they may enter the tent, and find an egg afterwards... but what will hatch? Nurture the egg in the Hatchery, then care for the offspring until they're ready to pledge allegiance to your Cult!

notes.title: Patch Notes 1.3.2 - Sins of the Flesh
notes.content:
Greetings, Cultists! 

It's the moment you have been waiting for. The Sins of the Flesh Update is now live for Cult of the Lamb! This is one of our most feature filled, cheekiest updates yet. Sins of the Flesh brings new features, rituals, buildings, fixes and much more - including a much missed old friend. 

We've prepared a special deep dive into the update here. If you're just after the patch notes straight up, find them below! 

Patch Notes 1.3.0 - Sins of the Flesh

New Features

 Added a new weapon - the Blunderbuss! Lamb goes pew pew. 
 Added 6 new Achievements.
 Eggs - Followers can be hatched from eggs! Golden eggs will grant special skins.
 New Resources have been added. These include Grapes, Hops, Cotton, Silk Thread, and Yolk. 
 Extra Resource rooms
 New Follower skins - Lemur, Caterpillar, Seal, Snake, Worm. 
 Extension of the Sozo questline
 Sin Doctrine category (4 new choices, 8 new Doctrines)
 Auto levelling up followers after sermons and rituals.
 Rebuilding structures mini game.
 Shop room inside the dungeon with an NPC (Berith) that sells unique clothing.
 Re-indoctrination option on the indoctrination podium.
 Outfit and necklace assigning option on the indoctrination screen.
 Disciple ritual that turns level 10 followers into Disciples.
 Followers will now fight with one another, causing injuries and sometimes death.
The Sin System 

 Followers generate sin which can be used as a new currency! Sin can be generated from specific Sin rituals and buildings. Spend it on upgrading the Temple, removing the cooldown on purgatory, re-indoctrinating followers and building structures.

New Rituals

 Rite of Lust - Followers will dance in their birthday suits around the shrine. Choose your favorite Follower to become the Mayflower Leader for half a day! This Follower will generate Sin. Followers will not work for half a day, instead they will prance around naked. 
 Rite of Wrath - Followers will cause havoc on the base! Choose a follower to become the Wrath Leader. This follower will generate Sin.
 Gluttony of Cannibals - Choose a follower to be consumed by others. This will generate Sin.
 Sinner’s Pride - Choose a follower to absorb the Sin of all followers.
 Discipleship - Choose a level 10 follower to become a Disciple, in your inner circle of true believers.

Buildings

 Drinkhouse - Craft drinks at the drinkhouse for your followers. Once a follower consumes their delicious little treat beverage, they will generate Sin. There is also chance to become Befuddled. They may need a little tactical spew to keep the festivities going. 
 Drinkhouse Level 2 - Queue more drinks.
 Mating Tent - You asked for it! When two Followers love each other very much, they may enter the tent, and find an egg afterwards... 
 Hatchery - Place eggs in the Hatchery to make them hatch. What will come out?
 Drum Circle - Play a drum circle mini game for a chosen follower to generate Sin.
 Tailor building to craft and assign clothing to followers.
 Bigger silo storage buildings for fertilizer and seeds.
 Janitor station 2 building.
 Seed Storage - Followers will collect seeds from this building and deposit them into Seed Silo’s.
 Fertilizer Storage - Followers will collect fertilizer from this building and deposit them into Fertilizer Silo’s.
 Disciple Collection Shrine - Allows Disciples to deposit devotion from other buildings into a central building.
 Disciple Boost Shrine - Allows Disciples to pray that eventually fills up a shrine to give the Lamb a boost for the next crusade.
Follower States

 Befuddled - Followers will stumble around, vomit, fight, chat, laugh, sing, and generally have a merry old time until they are no longer befuddled.
 Injured - Followers will limp around feeling sorry for themselves until they are no longer injured.

Chore Levelling Up

 When cleaning a poop/vomit/burnt or cleaning out an outhouse, XP will be generated.
 Once the chore XP bar reaches full, the Lamb will unlock a new mop. There are as many as 10 (!!!) mops to unlock.
 The higher the mop, the faster the Lamb can clean. 

Poop variations

 Golden Poop - Drops gold when cleaned. Drops gold/gold bars when harvesting a crop fertilized with golden poop.
 Glow Poop - Attracts fireflies.
 Devotion Poop - Generates devotion when cleaned. Crop fertilized with devotion poop will generate devotion over time.
 Massive Poop - Drops multiple poops when cleaned. Followers can get stuck in the massive poop :( 
 Poop pet - Drops a poop pet when harvested, only when the poop is from a follower with the poop skin.
 Rainbow poop - Gives 5 times the chore XP when harvested. Instantly grows a crop when fertilized with rainbow poop.

Lore Tablets

 15 Lore Tablets to collect across the game! 
 Hover for locations of Tablets: [spoiler]10 are located in a special dungeon room. 2 are located in a dungeon graveyard. 3 are located in special NPC encounter rooms.[/spoiler]

Traits

 Disciple Trait - Can re-educate Dissenters and use special Shrines.
 Jerk Trait - Jeers at the lamb. Chance to steal Lamb’s gold. Will tell the Lamb they suck after a failed crusade.
 Hot Tempered Trait - May start a fight with other followers.
 Royal Pooper Trait - Only poops golden poops. Say that 5 times fast. 
 Scared Trait - Runs away from the player. Can be bullied/reassured.
 Terrified Trait - Sits in the corner of base and cries. :( 
 Lustful Trait - Increases odds of mating in the mating tent.
 Celibate Trait - Decreases odds of mating in the mating tent.
 Fashionable Trait - Generates Devotion 20% faster when wearing a unique outfit.
 Hedonist Trait - Decreases productivity by 10% but increases Sin generation by 15%.
 Ascetic Trait - Decreases Sin generation by 10% but increases productivity by 15%.
 Virtuous Trait - Produces Sin 20% slower.
 Unrepentant - Produces Sin 15% faster.
 Doctrinal Extremist Cult Trait - Choose to generate Sin from the Confession Booth instead of Loyalty.
 Violent Extremist Cult Trait - Chance of Sin appearing as a reward from mini-bosses.
 Fertility Cult Trait - Followers hatched in the Cult will be born with some Sin
 Allegiance Cult Trait - Followers hatched in the Cult will be born with a high Loyalty level.
 Dissented Followers have a chance to show up inside the dungeon and fight the player.

Twitch Integration Update

 Added outfits for viewer followers! Viewers can now select a snazzy outfit in the follower builder after they win a follower raffle.
 Added mobile support. You can now use all of the integration’s features on your mobile devices as well!
 Added additional Help/Hinder outcomes

Changes

 Follower level is now capped at 10 - Followers at max level can can still participate in any interactions or Cult events that would normally increase their loyalty, but their loyalty bar will not appear anymore.
 Balanced the Enrichment Ritual.
 Added prompt to signify that sacrificing followers in certain locations are permanent .
 Laplace Dice is now a single use relic.
 Paean demon will no longer give hearts whilst wearing the Berseker or Fragile Fortitude Fleeces.
 Rebalancing commandment stones from levelling of Followers.
 Remove necklace option.
 Hide/Show necklace option.
 Skip sermons.
 Followers level capped at level 10.
 Dissenters who have left the cult have a chance to show up in the dungeon and fight the Lamb.
 Achievements menu that displays unlocked achievements.
 Fixed confusion with end of level bonus items

Bug Fixes

 Fixed demons not joining in the final fight.
 Fixed certain follower questlines
 Fixed lighting issues with blood moon ritual
 Fixed Morgue and Crypt issues
 Fixed birds displaying above the base in photo mode
 Fixed certain weapons not showing on crusades

Sinful DLC Pack

 6 tailor unlocked outfits
 6 new decorations
 5 new Follower skins: Tiger, Llama, Hammerhead, Ladybug, Sphynx
 1 player fleece
As an addition : 2 tailor outfits for Heretic pack, and 2 tailor outfits for Cultist pack.

notes.title: Cult of the Lamb’s first Major Content Update is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Relics of the Old Faith is an ENORMOUS free update to Cult of the Lamb. We’ve listened to many of your requests and have been working since launch to add everything we possibly could. There’s so much that it can’t fit into one News post, but we’re going to try…
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/6c3e673901f9d816442450b618cc6ab8f0f822bc.gif

New Post-Game Storyline
After defeating the final boss, a mysterious otherworldly being gives the Lamb a new task.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/c22b5e5655d77dc0747dc329ba3aa28b63436ab5.gif
Revamped Boss Fights and Enemies
In the new Post-Game, every boss has been revamped with new and tougher attack patterns. We know many of you asked for more combat depth and difficulty, so this is just one of the ways we're adding your requests in Relics of the Old Faith.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3db178a0ef3a887649c10e0c95ef6dbe527572da.gif
Post-Game Progression
Crusading against these new challenges will also bring new rewards. The mystic seller will grant the Lamb many useful items that will allow you to mandate previously missed doctrines, grant new Follower abilities with necklaces and unlock new Follower forms!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/496a9898694306767476ee9fafcca3e251df4f2d.gif
Relics to Collect and Combat
So what are these Relics of the Old Faith? Relics are an entirely new combat system that we've added for the Lamb to collect and combat. From the Eye of Leshy to Clauneck's Shoe, each of these ideological items will grant a powerful new ability for your crusades.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/646f61a43f51c8e40c902e8ab426692c2da1edde.gif
Chemach 
This curious character is the keeper of the Relics of the Old Faith. When you encounter them on your crusades, you’ll learn more about these mysterious items and their place in the world.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3db20e23fa43960712525c8e366bf36c722cb4d6.gif
Heavy Attacks 
Each of the 5 weapon types now features a Heavy Attack. Throw your Axe like a boomerang, spawn a ranged assault of Daggers, or spin in a Gauntlet tornado to match whatever situation you find yourself in. Heavy attacks can be upgraded to an even stronger form. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/27eb28908d49bd787f46e58a011cbbc8d1081a2a.gif
It’s a (New) Trap!
The Lamb can’t be the only one with new ways to fight. Shielded enemies, moving rivers and swinging axes are a few of the new tricks in the heretics’ arsenal. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/1b61083388641bd6041a1cc6e90efd6aad3a19c6.gif
Purgatory and Challenge Runs
In Purgatory, there are new crusading challenges like the Boss Rush and the Dungeon Gauntlet. With 5 new Fleeces and an added Permadeath mode, you can customize your very own combat experience. And yes, you can tackle the final boss fight on the same save file!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/6bc3aef68829e617d83866990345f78d5fd92630.gif
Surprises and Secrets
During your crusades, you may encounter familiar friends and foes. What is Midas doing in Darkwood? Who’s causing beef between the Lighthouse Keeper and the Mushroomos? 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/0cb0b1d4f4264456fa04e0ab521f9a06cdf8abf0.gif
New Buildings for Better Cults
Hollup, let them cook! We’ve added 5 new structures to help manage your Cult. Followers can cook in the Kitchen, have sleepovers in Shared Shelters, and organize their farms. The Crypt and the Morgue will also let you deal with pesky dying Followers more efficiently!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/b5eba7e11c4a2a05f79da527ee12109ef60e9f27.gif
Special Boss Followers
The new Post-Game story will allow you to convert the 4 bishops as Followers! Maybe you’ll figure out how to get a few cute kitties to join you, too. This is along with 11 new Follower forms and 7 that were previously exclusive outside of the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/af922fda7a911969bfaf9286e291fec24d29fef6.gif
Photo Mode
Photo Mode will give you a whole new point of view! Change the angle, zoom in, and decorate with 88 different stickers to make your own memories in your Cult and during crusades. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3b5432e8caab49c34f53985735171effcd75fca8.gif
Playing Your Way with Accessibility
You can now pause time at your Cult while you are crusading on a dungeon run! If you want to focus on the combat while your Followers stay healthy, this is the option for you. We’ve also added several new text options like dyslexic fonts in English, changing roman numerals to numbers and toggling high contrast text, text styling and the Build Mode filter. 
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/8cd9efac30b5fa5c58e70d28883499a0fdd8b887.gif
New Achievements and Collections
For the completionists, we’ve introduced more achievements, tarot cards, quests, sermon upgrades and so much more! 

Heretic Pack
[previewyoutube=8VDs24K8_xY;full][/previewyoutube]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2331540/Cult_of_the_Lamb_Heretic_Pack/

I think you can see that this update is truly enormous. We never expected that so many people would play our game and we’ve put as much as we possibly could into Relics of the Old Faith. 

We want to make Cult of the Lamb the best game it can be and that’s why this Major Content Update is entirely free. 

If you’d like to continue supporting us, we’ve released the Heretic Pack which is purely cosmetic DLC. We're also going to put the game on its biggest sale yet, so it’s the perfect time to join the Cult! 

You’ve shown us so much devotion so far and we are so happy that we can all enjoy this huge release together. 

This is for all of you,

Thank you

Full Patch Notes - Version 1.2.0

New Content

 Added a new storyline which begins after completing the base game.
 Added 37 new Relics with various powers which must be collected by the player.
 All 5 Weapons got a new Heavy Attack and Level 2 Heavy Attack.
 Added new Sermon upgrades that unlock extra damage, Relics, Heavy Attacks, and a new ability to reroll your Weapons and Curses on Crusades.
 Added new Crusades, which are encountered after the base game.
 Added 13 new Encounters with various Characters and cutscenes.
 Added many new Combat rooms, with new traps such as rivers, swinging axes, etc.
 Added Fish, Meat, and Relic rooms.
 Added 6 new Enemies to fight in new Crusades.
 Added 16 new Minibosses to fight in new Crusades.
 Added 4 new Bishop transformations to fight in new Crusades.
 Added Chemach - a new Character who deals Relics.
 Added ??? - a new Character who provides quests and opens a shop that accepts God Tears.
 Added Forgotten Commandment Stones  - a new resource used to unlock Doctrines you didn’t choose in the past.
 Added 6 new Necklaces to obtain in ???’s shop.
 Added 7 new Tarot Cards to collect.
 Added 2 new Critters - Jellyfish in Anchordeep and Relic Goat from Relics.
 Added 4 new Buildings - Kitchen, Shared Shelter, Crypt, and Morgue with some having additional upgrades.
 Added 11 new Followers obtainable in various ways through gameplay, and 7 previous Twitch Followers obtainable through ???’s shop.
 Added 2 new Twitch Follower Forms only currently obtainable as Twitch Drops for Steam (will be available for other platforms in the future through normal gameplay.)
 Added 6 new special Followers - Leshy, Heket, Kallamar, Shamura, Baal, and Aym.
 Added new quests, including some secret quests.
 Added 5 new Fleeces - obtained through various quests and combat.
 Added Purgatory - a new way to fight in Dungeon Gauntlet and Boss Rush. Use Fleeces to fight in new ways against bosses from the base game.
 Added the ability to re-fight Baal, Aym, and The One Who Waits in Purgatory.
Settings
Photo Mode
 Added a Photo Mode that allows you to tilt, change height, and focus, and take Photos while pausing the game.
 Added a Gallery to view your Photos taken while using Photo Mode.
 Added Edit option in Gallery that allows the player to add, scale, flip, rotate and undo Stickers.
 Added 88 new Stickers, with the ability to Clear and Undo.
General

 Can now toggle a setting to display follower names above their heads.
 Tutorial tooltips can now be navigated with the mouse.
 Tutorial tooltips now show button controls.
 A Permadeath Mode has now been added, unlocked after finishing the base game once.
Accessibility

 Dyslexic Fonts (English only) - font option to allow easier reading for those with dyslexia.
 Numbers as Roman Numerals - change roman numerals in the game to arabic numerals.
 Stop Time on Crusade - time will pause in the Cult while visiting Crusades.
 Show Build Mode Filter - the player is now able to turn off the full screen blue build mode filter.
 High Contrast text option - sets text to a clearer color where appropriate for an easier reading experience.
 Remove Text Styling - you can now turn off all bold and italic text for an easier reading experience.
 Main Menu Dark Mode - change the main menu to dark mode.
 The Flashing Lights option has been improved.
Remove Lighting Effects - turn off various lighting and day/night visual effects. 
Achievements

 Relics of the Old Faith - Collect all Relics.
 Shake Down - Get your Coin back from Midas.
 True Love Found - Reunite Aym and Baal with Forneus.
 Leader of Leaders - Indoctrinate all five Bishops into your Cult.
Heretic DLC Pack

 Added 5 new Follower Forms.
 Added 8 new Decorations.
 Added a new decorative Fleece.
Balancing & Bug Fixes

 Fishing rates were adjusted to prevent the player from fishing too long.
 Mushroom drops in Anura were raised.
 Dagger damage was raised slightly.
 Fleece of the Diseased Heart was rebalanced with an added dodging minigame.
 The Shrine will no longer give Coins when completing upgrades after the base game and gives God Tears instead.
 Cloud shadows were enabled again after accidentally being disabled on PC.
 Many optimizations were added to smooth gameplay for lower memory hardware.
 Some miscellaneous general improvements.
 Many small bug fixes.

notes.title: Major Update and RELICS OF THE OLD FAITH
notes.content:
Happy New Year, devoted followers of the Lamb! And what better way to start the year than with some blessings in the form of an update to Cult of the Lamb. Here’s a taster of what’s coming your way:

Blessed be thy name.
Finger slip when you were naming your Cult? Or maybe it was funny at the time, but now not so much? Use your Book of Doctrines to rename your Cult anytime.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/6fe44c97af7a6faea7f35a42047e10c3fbb13bc9.gif

Blessed be thy stats.
Your Book of Doctrines will also now display your statistics - your Crusades, Kills, Followers, and their fates. A great way to keep track of the holy history of the Lamb!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/a74905a87e87863c7ea562f3278566f2ec9e41db.gif

Blessed be thy controller.
Some have a specific way to play - we hear you! Fully customise your controls for optimal heretic-slaying efficiency.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/9d5513413cffafae87c4bbd393c833102c903c74.gif

Blessed be thy cooking… and fishing.
A successful Cult means a lot of mouths to feed! You will now be able to enable Auto-Cooking and Auto-Fishing from the Accessibility menu in Settings. That’s right, every dish and fish will be an automatic success!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/cacbaf3c594e1d5f94119069d71ed7dd16cdebb6.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/319f8ef3bf21ef365a7cba8311c0ddef8227c61a.gif

Blessed be thy blessings.
We get it, you’re a busy Lamb, you don’t have time to Bless every. Single. Follower. Well, fret no more - the Lamb can now Bless, Inspire, or Intimidate multiple Followers at once within an area. You get a Blessing, you get a Blessing!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/da847883228984fac4e2d47719b453148817e8f1.gif

These updates will help the Lamb navigate the changing Lands of the Old Faith in time for the release of our first FREE Major Content Update! That’s right, faithfully follow the Lamb into…

RELICS OF THE OLD FAITH
Coming early 2023

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/3de10376ac649880141659238bc7d1dc2cea7957.gif

Featuring new challenges, enemies, and ways to keep non-believers in line. There’s plenty to look forward to so Praise the Lamb and join us for Relics of the Old Faith.

And to keep the blessings rolling, we’ll have a second - that’s right, second! - Major Content Update coming mid-year, which will focus on adding depth and detail to your Cult management gameplay.

notes.title: Sneak Peek of the first Cult MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE to celebrate our biggest sale!
notes.content:
Thank you for an amazing year

After years of work, we released Cult of the Lamb in 2022. It has reached so many more people than we could have ever imagined and that's thanks to every single of one of you who have played and supported our little Lamb. 

We appreciate your loyalty to the Lamb and to say thank you, we're ending this year with the first reveal of our FREE Major Content Update. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/38fe867894f7bcfbf7a6188677a02ba65a33cece.png

Holiday Specials

Before we get to the new content, we wanted to share our Holiday Specials. To celebrate the season, Cult of the Lamb is currently on its BIGGEST SALE EVER at 25% off here on Steam! 

We have also released two new Follower Forms, the Penguin and the Lion. These are available as Twitch Drops by watching participating streamers play the game until January 5. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/608053f25af6dcaa6f62d49b2b4e278743f66a6a.gif

And we have been nominated for Outstanding Visual Style in the Steam Awards. Vote! Vote! Vote!

It's the perfect time to dive into the Darkwood and find out what the little Lamb is all about with lots of new content around the corner.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/248e79d45ac546ed29a14eada17596a23a0ed057.png

Free Major Content Update - Sneak Preview

Along with fixes and improvements, we have been working on adding more depth to the game. Based on your feedback, this major content update will focus on combat and dungeon gameplay. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/5b62caf5d733a991d6063f7b68c8d4041c79e2dc.gif

The Lamb has some new moves! Press and hold the attack button for a HEAVY ATTACK! This new sword move can knock back many enemies in one SMASH when you're being swarmed. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/1a861e5957b59f9c810a6d8e974574a4868e11c9.gif

Each weapon type has its own Heavy Attack.  This Axe boomerang throw provides a ranged option. Charge the Axe throw to launch it in a straight line before it flies back to your new position, slicing enemies both ways. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/e87283f866a31bdec178c32518f6b70ca4e4e394.gif

The Dagger's Heavy Attack spawns pain from the sky. Multiple Daggers will drop in a line and each of them will knock enemies farther away.

and so much more!

Adding a new attack to each weapon will give you more options in every encounter. However, we're also working on many other new features that will add depth, difficulty, accessibility and quality of life. We've been listening to your feedback and are addressing the most requested improvements in this free Major Content Update. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/89b089e9e459c884dd25d6ebd7f766c507397b04.gif

Can you spot anything different about Barbatos? There will be many good reasons to rematch against your favorite foes. 

We have another round of fixes scheduled for the very start of the New Year but after that, we will be working on this Major Content Update. It's A LOT so it will take more time in the cooking pot. 

We don't say this enough but thank you for enjoying our game. We hope you have a great New Year! 

Love and devotion from the Massive Monster team

notes.title: 10 Days to Join the Cult
notes.content:
We are lunching in 10 DAYS! (and other news)  

Yes, you read that right, Cult of the Lamb will launch at lunchtime (EDT) on August 11. 

When is lunchtime? Well, that's part of the fun! You can expect it to be available around the middle of the day-ish on August 11. (EDT - New York timezone) 

That also means that there's less than 10 days to get the Cthulhu Follower Form! It is exclusive as a Pre-Purchase bonus which means that after the game launches, there will not be any way to make a cult of cute Cthulhu's worshipping the Lamb. {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/71db1c05f0674412039d48517c68fef87624a75d.gif

More Features
While you can get a taste of the core combat and management gameplay in the Cult of the Lamb Demo, there are many other features that add depth while bolstering your Cult. I'll share a few of my favourites in this Dev Blog. 

Weddings and relationships
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/633e6cdd169f4d1f5755ca759d6aa81dad8fbb11.gif
What is a Cult leader without a faithful partner at their side? Each Follower will have their own loyalty level towards you. There are many ways to boost their loyalty like blessing them, giving them gifts and yes, accepting their marriage proposals. Since this is an authentic Cult, of course you can marry as many Followers as you'd like. But the more you spread out your love, the more jealous your other spouses will get! 

Just keep fishing
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/ef0ac26872bc44cefe634f94e5b7059bde5ab8f1.gif
All the best games have fishing minigames! At Pilgrim's Passage, you can join the Fisherman to cast a line into open waters. The fish are plentiful but certain kinds are rarer than others. You can cook your catch in several different recipes or trade your best specimens to the Fisherman for Holy Talisman Pieces. These can be used to impact your dungeon gameplay through swappable permanent modifiers. 

The Trials of the tarot
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/b31eec0eb367ef513bfab3d921d2de84ff11b826.gif
Speaking of dungeon runs, you may encounter Clauneck, the Dealer of cards and Teller of fortunes. They will give you a choice of two tarot cards. Each card will buff your dungeon run in a different way so you'll need to choose wisely depending on your preferred playstyle. There are 36 different cards to unlock and you may find them in some curious places around the world!

Knucklebones, a dice game of risk and reward
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41116610/a3182f5caa7ea84241bd566ba03ac5f659ffb43c.gif
When you want to make a quick buck, you can try your luck at Knucklebones. Matching dice🎲 gives you powerful multipliers but also makes them susceptible to getting destroyed. Will you spread your dice out to fill the board quickly or risk your matches for the big money multipliers? 

You can read a full step-by-step explanation in this Twitter thread!
